title: Type a game's name to open it
items: Every game now has an address you can type: ascoding11.com/ followed by its name, like ascoding11.com/slipstream or ascoding11.com/driftfall.
ascoding11.com/backroom opens the whole Back Room.
Clicking around the site still keeps the address the same as before.
